chunks: Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Sinani al-Mukattab narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Harun al-Sufi narrated to us. He said: 'Ubaydallah b. Musa al-Habbal al-Tabari narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn al-Khashab narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Muhsin narrated to us from Yunus b. Thibyan. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said:

Surely, the people worship Allah, mighty and exalted, for three reasons. One group worships Him out of desire for His reward — that is the worship of the possessive, and it is of greed. Others worship Him out of fear of the Fire — that is the worship of the slaves, and it is of fright. But I worship Him out of love for Him, mighty and exalted — that is the worship of the nobles, and it is of safety.

As He, mighty and exalted, says: "and they will be safe from the horror of that Day" [27:89], and as He, mighty and exalted, says: "Say: If you love Allah, then follow me; Allah will love you and forgive your sins" [3:31].
So whoever loves Allah, Allah will love him; and whoever Allah, mighty and exalted, loves, he will be among the safe ones.

key_terms.عِبَادَةُ الْحُرَصَاءِ: Worship of the possessive — driven by greed for reward
key_terms.عِبَادَةُ الْعَبِيدِ: Worship of the slaves — driven by fear of punishment
key_terms.عِبَادَةُ الْكِرَامِ: Worship of the nobles — driven by pure love for God

ai.seo_question: What are the three types of worship according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) classifies worship into three categories: worship driven by desire for reward (greed), worship driven by fear of punishment (servile fear), and worship driven by pure love for God (the way of the noble). He identifies his own worship as the third kind and links it to divine safety, citing Quran 27:89 ("they will be safe from the horror of that Day") and Quran 3:31 ("Say: If you love Allah, follow me, and Allah will love you and forgive your sins").

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Sinani al-Mukattib narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Harun al-Sufi narrated to us. He said: `Ubaydallah b. Musa al-Habbal al-Tabari narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn al-Khashab narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Muhsan narrated to us from Yunus b. Thibyan. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said:

Surely, the people worship Allah for three reasons. (1) One group worship Him out of desire for His reward – that is the worship of the possessive, and it is of greed. (2) Others who worship out of fear of the Fire – that is the worship of the slaves, and it is of fright. (3) But, I worship Him out of love for Him – that is the worship of the nobles, and it is of safety,
as He says, “and they will be safe from the horror of that day” [27:89], and as He says, “Say: If you love Allah, then follow me; and Allah will love you and forgive your sins.” [3:31]
Whoever loves Allah, Allah will love him; and whoever Allah loves, he will be of the safe ones.
